subject: Render blit test root cause hint: view copy mutates dst before full-buffer assertion
body: Read-only analysis of the abort at current render_encoder_host_test.inc test_blit_completeness: line100 creates view=[dst newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:71] (zero-copy, same buffer), then line101 copies src 4x4 into view at origin0, which aliases dst. Line108 subsequently asserts all 256 bytes dp[i]==bp[i] (the original buffer->dst copy), so the earlier view overlay necessarily changes the first 4x4 region. This looks like the test needs to assert the view overlay separately or perform it after the full-buffer check; it is not evidence against the copy path. Render-owned file; I did not edit it. Current render harness f7059247 / encoder e9c94841. This is the only remaining integration-required failure after my native gate string fix; candidate otherwise PASS at 939 checks.
